names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 2720, «Феодотия Римская, мц.», with the rank word after the comma left off. The day line gives «Мчч. Феодота и Феодотии», the bare forename in the genitive, so the epithet is read from the name link. `fk.mjs` returns no holder for «римская феодотия».

death.note: The year the day line prints for the pair: «Мчч. Феодота и Феодотии (108).» Neither her name page nor his gives anything further, and no life page exists for either.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 июля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Феодота и Феодотии (108).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links to the two names and to no reading, and name page 2720 prints the title and «День памяти: 4 июля» and nothing else. She is named in one breath with the martyr Theodotus, whose name page 2222 gives him the same epithet «Римский» and the same single day; that man is the folder `theodotus-martyr-4-july`, which the Greek calendar already keeps on this menologion day, and a `related` row joins them both ways. `theodotia-of-asia` was read before this folder was made and is a different woman — a venerable of the Julian 1 November whose name page lists that day and no other. azbyka.ru was not read.
